Name: Icon, Minor
Source: Lyres Guide to Risk and Reward
Information: Minor Icons are typically small animals such as birds, cats, dogs, etc. They are often kept by residents of the planes they are in as pets or family guardians, though they resist any concept of ownership and live in accord with whomever they choose to. Being visited by or living around such a creature is considered a sign of good luck, and its presence raises the spirits of its companions.

traits.name: Telempathetic Discouragement
traits.description: When a creature targets the icon with an attack or effect intended to cause harm to it while within range of its telepathy, the attacker must succeed on a DC 12 Charisma saving throw or be charmed for 1 minute. A creature charmed this way shares the icon’s feelings, becoming discouraged from violence and (though the icon holds no direct sway over their actions) they must contend with their guilt before further harming it. A creature that fails can repeat the saving throw at the start of each of their turns and each time they take damage, ending the effect on a successful save. A creature that succeeds any save against this effect becomes immune to it and the Telempathetic Discouragement of any icon with a CR of 1 or lower for 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The icon makes two attacks: one with its Bite and one with its Claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 4 (1d6) radiant damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Illuminate
bonus_actions.description: The icon causes its body to glow as though by the light spell, granting soft light of a color it chooses in a radius centered on it, which can have a radius of 5 to 20 feet, with another sphere of dim light extending twice as far. It can use this action again to adjust or dispel this light.
